spans.s:
A short vowel is the substitute of प्रातिपदिक which ends with the word गो 'a cow' and of that which ends with what has as its termination a feminine affix, when regarded as उपसर्जन।

Terms: प्रातिपदिक

The affix मयट् comes after the word गो in the sense of 'its dung'.

Terms: मयट्

The affix खञ् comes in the sense of 'it formerly had been' after the word गोष्ठ।

Terms: खञ्

The affix वुन् comes in the sense of मतुप् when an अध्याय or अनुवाक is to be expressed

Terms: वुन्

The word गोष्पद is formed by सुट् , when meaning a locality visited or not visited by cows, or when it means quantity.

Terms: सुट् augment
